headline: A-Share Reduction Oversight Fully Upgraded: Heavy Penalties Take Effect! Tianyu Biotech Actual Controller Luo Weiguo Fined 35.6 Million in Single Case, Record for the Year
summary: China's regulator fined Luo Weiguo, actual controller of Tianyu Biotech, 35.6 million yuan in a single case, a record for the year, as stricter penalties for A-share share-reduction breaches take effect.
why: Share-reduction rules limit major shareholders' sales, and enforcement affects governance and investor confidence in A-share companies.
